% Stable assumption identities; scope clarifications are owner-directed.
\newcommand{\NormAssumptions}{\Unit{Assumptions, required method record and claim ceilings}{core:assumptions}{%
\begin{description}
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-001: compatible arithmetic.]
Every additive equality/difference/cancellation uses exact pairwise quantity,
unit/scale, frame/domain, grid/sampling, support, origin/reference/gauge,
null-space, calibration and response compatibility, including declared affine/
quotient arithmetic and state. Missing premises block affected claims.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-002: fixed residual linearity.]
The map-valued distributive expansion requires complete $F_k=A_k$ exact fixed
linear on declared spaces/support/state. Fixed basis or recomputation alone is
insufficient; affine offsets remain unless the premise actually holds.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-003: complete fixed linearity.]
$A_k,\Pi_k,B_k$ are all exact fixed linear on compatible spaces, units, support,
state and conditioning before defining $D_k$, its linear applied-model response
or the exact four-term covariance. General fixed derivatives require their own
explicit differentiability/tangent/comparability premises, not this assumption.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-004: joint conditional covariance.]
In addition to ASM-003, compatible real vector coordinates, finite joint second
moments and exact law-relative $\Op$ are required, with applied-model axes,
reference/gauge/null-space state and both cross terms. Physical/random-parent, explicit fixed-realized-model and conditional NOI
randomization laws are distinct. Pre-outcome is relative to each declared random
event; NOI may condition on realized parent and exact successful design resolution.
FRUIT outcome-conditioned targets need separate method/estimand authority.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-005: response comparison.]
Bind exact numerical-fixed versus prescribed-rerun query, domains/codomain,
state/support/branch/reference/gauge comparison and convention. A derivative
requires existence on compatible tangent spaces. A finite difference has a
separate convention and is not a substituted fixed-branch derivative.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-006: causal continuation.]
All future-consequential state, compatible profile and the same future controls
are required for equality with uninterrupted execution. A selected array alone
is insufficient; no replay or numerical sufficiency is established by this core.
\end{description}
Assumptions are conditional premises, not numerical evidence.

Every method-specific record shall satisfy all twenty-one complete binding
classes in REQ-023 and their exact obligations in the scientific sections.
Optional absence needs core-and-method permission and a reason. A filled
template supplies neither actual authority nor numerical availability.

No numerical method/route, representation/response/covariance fidelity, recovered
measured mode, uncertainty coverage, convergence adequacy, Pointing/OOF/catalogue
fitness, observational validation, performance, readiness, production suitability/
authorization or Unity activity is claimed. Implementation is not assessed;
numerical conformance/experiments are not performed. Numerical development,
qualification and policy recommendation retain separate owner decisions and
independent-pointing evidence obligations; no evidence plan is supplied here.
}}
